verdict.rationale: The product is an Agent Skill driven entirely through natural-language conversation with Claude or any skills-capable agent. You simply ask for a logo and the agent picks up the skill from its description (gh-22, gh-1, gh-19). Choosing a direction, requesting changes and asking for the full kit all happen as conversational turns (gh-2, gh-3, gh-4), shown in a worked client example (gh-5). Missing for 10: independent or third-party hands-on corroboration of the conversational workflow.
